assignments.essential_function: Turn prepared results into suitable, clearly labeled static or interactive charts with accessible presentation.

review: Read complete unchanged SKILL.md, including its Python examples. Covers chart selection, Matplotlib/Seaborn/Plotly examples, scales, labeling, accessible color and data-table alternatives. A practical plotting/design guide, not an analysis or inference engine. Examples expect appropriately prepared data; no scripts were executed and plot-library compatibility has not been empirically tested. Individual path history unavailable because the public GitHub API rate limit was reached; repository activity is recorded separately.
